title: Pregel: A System for Large-Scale Graph Processing
authors: Grzegorz Malewicz, Matthew H. Austern, Aart J. C. Bik, James C. Dehnert, Ilan Horn, Naty Leiser, Grzegorz Czajkowski
description: Describes Pregel, Google's vertex-centric Bulk Synchronous Parallel framework for large-scale graph computation, in which vertices exchange messages across synchronous supersteps, enabling PageRank, shortest paths, and other graph algorithms to run on graphs with billions of vertices.
